claim_boundary.allowed: records layout-risk assumptions for CrossSim-backed analog-allowed MatMul rows
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not prove analog macro layout, extraction, DRC/LVS, calibrated silicon, measured board performance, or production readiness

array.weight_storage: signed weights represented as conductance-coded terms before digital correction

rows.claim_effect: physical layout risk record only; does not upgrade to analog macro signoff

column_current.assumption: local dimension-scaled estimate for review; not measured current

converter.adc_range: bounded by local tile operating point; no measured silicon range
converter.dac_precision: activation code is split into DAC-driven row-voltage steps

model_boundary.accepted_residual_boundary: residual-aware placement allowed this row, but layout risk is checked separately

issues: ADC range is coarse for a positive analog claim
DAC precision needs digital scaling and error budget
row-wire loss is visible and must stay in the layout boundary
converter error is a first-order part of the analog result
model sensitivity is high enough that small physical shifts need review

wire.assumption: single local row-drop case, not extracted routed macro parasitics
